ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to approximately 15% of the visible surface area, primarily at distal tips and discrete spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling at the outer left lobe tip; distinct diagonal white parallel bands at the outer right lobe tip; discrete white circular spots scattered across the central-left lobe quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Standard V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 90 degrees and a shallow depth relative to total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged topography along the entire trailing edge; a significant high-amplitude rectangular indentation (missing tissue) at the distal end of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing margins, with irregular truncation at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent circular white ring (rosette) on the lower-central right lobe; cluster of small circular high-intensity spots on the left lobe margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single, distinct horizontal linear pixel disruption (scratch) extending through the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant macro-level indentation/tissue loss at the outer right lobe tip; large circular ring-shaped scar on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive diagonal rake-like pigmentation pattern on the distal right lobe margin.
